arabic_text: وَ عَلى أخيهِ وَ ابْنِ عَمِّهِ،
english_text: and (bless) his brother and his cousin,

arabic_text: اللَّذَيْنِ لَمْ يُشْرِكا بِكَ طَرْفَةَ عَيْن أبَداً،
transliteration: alladhīna lam yushrikā bika ţarfata aynin 'abadā,
english_text: neither of whom ever took associates with You (in worship) even for one moment,

arabic_text: وَ عَلى فاطِمَةَ الزَّهْراءِ سَيِّدةِ نِساءِ الْعالَمينَ،
transliteration: wa alā fāţimataz-zahrā'i sayyidati nisā'il ālamīn,
english_text: and (bless) Fatima, the radiant, and the chief of the ladies of the worlds,

arabic_text: وَ عَلى سَيِّدَىْ شَبابِ أهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُسَيْنِ،
transliteration: wa alā sayyiday shabābi 'ahlil jannah, al-ħasani wal ħusayn,
english_text: and (bless) the two masters of the youth of Paradise, al-Hasan and al-Husain,

arabic_text: صَلاةً خالِدَةَ الدَّوامِ،
english_text: With an everlasting blessing,

arabic_text: عَدَدَ قَطْرِ الرِّهامِ،
english_text: equal to the number of drops of rains,

arabic_text: وَ زِنَةَ الْجِبالِ وَ الآكامِ،
english_text: and the weight of the mountains and hills,

arabic_text: ما أوْرَقَ السَّلامُ،
english_text: until peace and salutations is ever exchanged,

arabic_text: وَ اخْتَلَفَ الضِّياءُ وَ الظَّلامُ،
english_text: and brightness (of day) and darkness (of night) are replaced.

arabic_text: وَ عَلى آلِهِ الطّاهِرينَ، الأئِمَّةِ الْمُهْتَدينَ،
english_text: And (bless) his pure family, (the rest of) the guided Imams,

arabic_text: الذّائِدينَ عَنِ الدّينِ،
english_text: the defenders of the religion,

arabic_text: عَلِيٍّ وَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ جَعْفَرٍ وَ مُوسى وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلِيٍّ وَ الْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُجَّةِ،
transliteration: aliyyin wa muħammadin wa jafarin wa mūsa wa aliyyin wa muħammadin wa aliyyin wal ħasani wal ħujjah,
english_text: (who are) Ali, Muhammad, Ja’far, Musa, Ali, Muhammad, Ali, al-Hasan, and al-Hujja,

arabic_text: الْقَوّامِ بِالْقِسْطِ، وَ سُلالَةِ السِّبْطِ،
english_text: the establishers of fairness, and the grandsons of the Prophet(PBUH&HF).

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنّي أسْئَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هذَا الإمامِ فَرَجاً قَريباً،
english_text: O Allah! I ask You by the rights of this Imam, a relief in the near future,

arabic_text: وَ صَبْراً جَميلا،
english_text: beautiful patience,

arabic_text: وَ نَصْراً عَزيزاً،
english_text: mighty triumph,

arabic_text: وَ غِنىً عَنِ الْخَلْقِ،
english_text: sufficiency from people,

arabic_text: وَ ثَباتاً فِي الْهُدى،
english_text: steadfastness in (the path of) guidance,

arabic_text: وَ التَّوْفيقَ لِما تُحِبُّ وَ تَرْضى،
english_text: success in what pleases and satisfies You,

arabic_text: وَ رِزْقاً واسِعاً حَلالا طَيِّباً،
english_text: a sustenance that is vast, lawful, pure,

arabic_text: مَريئاً دارّاً سائِغاً،
english_text: adequate, fruitful, pleasant,

arabic_text: فاضِلاً مُفَضِّلاً صَبّاً صَبّاً،
english_text: abundant, superior, pouring forth,

arabic_text: مِنْ غَيْرِ كَدّ وَ لا نَكَد، وَ لا مِنَّة مِنْ أحَد،
transliteration: min ghayri kaddin wa lā nakad, wa lā minnatin min 'aħad,
english_text: without any toil, trouble, and favor from anyone.

arabic_text: وَ عافِيَةً مِنْ كُلِّ بَلاء وَ سُقْم وَ مَرَض،
transliteration: wa āfiyatan min kulli balā'in wa suqmin wa marađh,
english_text: Preserve my health against any affliction, ailment, and disease,

arabic_text: وَ الشُّكْرَ عَلَى الْعافِيَةِ وَ النَّعْماءِ،
english_text: Grant me appreciation of well-being and blessings,

arabic_text: وَ إذا جاءَ الْمَوْتُ فَاقْبِضْنا عَلى أحْسَنِ ما يَكُونُ لَكَ طاعَةً،
transliteration: wa 'idhā jā'al mawtu faqbidhnā alā 'aħsani mā yakūnu laka ţā'ah,
english_text: And when the time of death arrives, take our soul while it is in the best condition of obedience to You,

arabic_text: عَلى ما أمَرْتَنا مُحافِظينَ حَتّى تُؤَدِّيَنا إلى جَنّاتِ النَّعيمِ،
transliteration: alā mā 'amartanā muħāfiđhīna ħattā ţu'addiyanā 'ilā jannātin-naīm,
english_text: And while observing what You commanded, so that You lead us to the Garden of blessings.

arabic_text: بِرَحْمَتِكَ يا أرْحَمَ الرّاحِمينَ،
english_text: By Your mercy, O the most merciful of the merciful!

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
transliteration: allāhumma šalli alā muħammadin wa āli muħammad,
english_text: My Allah! Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

arabic_text: وَ أوْحِشْني مِنَ الدُّنْيا وَ آنِسْني بِالآخِرَةِ،
transliteration: wa 'awħishnī minad-dunyā wa ānisnī bil ākhirah,
english_text: and estrange me from (the attractions of) the world, and make me familiar with (the affairs of) the hereafter.
